config.bloodmoonevents.title: Bloodmoon Events
config.bloodmoonevents.needs_cloth: Install Cloth Config to edit these settings in-game. Until then, edit config/bloodmoonevents.json and run /bloodmoon reload.
config.bloodmoonevents.server_note: These settings apply to singleplayer and to worlds hosted from this computer. On a dedicated server, edit the server's own config/bloodmoonevents.json instead.
config.bloodmoonevents.compat_note: Only used when RPG Advanced Difficulty is installed.
config.bloodmoonevents.intervalNights.to: A Blood Moon rises every this many nights (7 = night 7, 14, 21...).
config.bloodmoonevents.firstNight.toolti: The earliest night that can be a Blood Moon.
config.bloodmoonevents.randomChance.tool: Extra chance (0-1) for any other night to become a Blood Moon.
config.bloodmoonevents.startTime.tooltip: Time of day (0-23999) the Blood Moon starts. 12600 is just after sunset.
config.bloodmoonevents.endTime.tooltip: Time of day the Blood Moon ends. 23200 is just before sunrise. Must be after the start time.
config.bloodmoonevents.warningTime.toolt: Time of day players are warned that tonight is a Blood Moon.
config.bloodmoonevents.preventSleeping.t: Players can't sleep through a Blood Moon.
config.bloodmoonevents.showTitle.tooltip: Show the "Blood Moon #N" title when it starts.
config.bloodmoonevents.skyTintStrength.t: How strongly the sky, fog and light turn red (0-1). Applies on this computer.
config.bloodmoonevents.moonScale.tooltip: How much bigger the moon gets (1 = vanilla size). Applies on this computer.
config.bloodmoonevents.maxLevel.tooltip: The Blood Moon number where difficulty stops growing. Every scaled value reaches its end value here.
config.bloodmoonevents.maxHordePerPlayer: Most horde mobs alive near each player.
config.bloodmoonevents.mobsPerWave.toolt: Mobs spawned around each player per wave.
config.bloodmoonevents.waveIntervalTicks: Time between spawn waves, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.bloodmoonevents.breakTicksPerHard: How long a zombie takes to break a block, per point of hardness (planks are 2). Several zombies on one block add up.
config.bloodmoonevents.armorChance.toolt: Chance (0-1) a zombie or skeleton spawns with extra armour. Higher levels also roll better materials.
config.bloodmoonevents.zombiesPlaceBlock: The Blood Moon number zombies start pillaring and bridging.
config.bloodmoonevents.zombiesBreakBlock: The Blood Moon number zombies start digging through blocks.
config.bloodmoonevents.creepersBreachFro: The Blood Moon number creepers start blowing through walls.
config.bloodmoonevents.slimeSuperJumpFro: The Blood Moon number slimes start jumping higher.
config.bloodmoonevents.longRangeTracking: The Blood Moon number the horde starts sensing players from further away.
config.bloodmoonevents.followRange.toolt: How far horde mobs track players through walls, in blocks.
config.bloodmoonevents.longFollowRange.t: Tracking range once long-range tracking unlocks.
config.bloodmoonevents.hordeSpawns.toolt: One mob per line: mob id, weight, first Blood Moon. For example "minecraft:zombie 40 1". Higher weight means more common.
Closest the horde spawns to a player, in blocks.
Furthest the horde spawns from a player, in blocks.
Also spawn the horde in caves when the player is underground.
config.bloodmoonevents.despawnAtDawn.too: Horde mobs vanish at dawn after dropping anything they picked up. When off, they stay as normal mobs.
config.bloodmoonevents.speedBonus.toolti: Movement speed bonus for every horde mob (0.1 = +10%).
config.bloodmoonevents.respectMobGriefin: Follow the mob_griefing gamerule for breaking, placing and creeper breaching.
config.bloodmoonevents.onlyHordeMobsUpgr: When off, every matching mob gets the upgraded AI during a Blood Moon.
config.bloodmoonevents.builderMobs.toolt: Mobs that can place and break blocks to reach players.
config.bloodmoonevents.zombiesPlaceBlock: Master switch for pillaring, steps and bridges.
config.bloodmoonevents.zombiesBreakBlock: Master switch for digging through blocks.
config.bloodmoonevents.maxBreakableHardn: Blocks harder than this are never broken (obsidian is 50).
config.bloodmoonevents.minBreakTicks.too: The shortest time any block takes to break, in ticks.
config.bloodmoonevents.protectContainers: Zombies never break chests, barrels, furnaces and other blocks that hold items.
config.bloodmoonevents.creepersBreach.to: Creepers that can't reach a player light their fuse anyway once close enough.
config.bloodmoonevents.creeperBreachDist: How close a stuck creeper has to be before it ignites, in blocks.
Slimes and magma cubes jump higher and lunge at players.
config.bloodmoonevents.restoreBrokenBloc: Blocks the horde breaks come back a few seconds after the Blood Moon ends, and drop nothing when broken. Off: horde damage is permanent.
config.bloodmoonevents.restoreOnlyPreexi: Only blocks that were there before the Blood Moon come back. Blocks placed during the night break and drop normally. Only matters when restoring is on.
Blocks the horde breaks drop as items. Restored blocks never drop.
config.bloodmoonevents.championChanceMul: How much more likely horde mobs are to spawn as champions.
config.bloodmoonevents.championTierGap.t: How much higher champion tiers catch up to tier 1 (0-0.95).
